notes.text: Six export rows package one fixed inventory each to satisfy the rectangular native schema; they are not independent observations. The 144 ordinary search, 9 synthetic solver-control and 12 reference executions remain individually identified and hash-bound in raw files and analysis.json.

positive_controls includes all three empty-clause controls and three positive-prefix controls; negative_controls includes three viable-prefix solver controls plus three separate certificate/model mutation checks.

Reference execution costs are included once for each of 12 reference cells; no multiplication across encodings or strategies. Complete/censored counts remain distinct from native package validity; a censored A/A pair is inconclusive.

Every phase retains its own units. Vector differences are instrument observations only, never total work/runtime advantage, intrinsic regularity or ECDLP recovery. Prior curves/targets were seen with another search instrument; no population or novelty inference.

Command includes export_packaging.py admitted after data. Unchanged frozen export_results.py performs all analysis; adapter changes only six aggregate instance labels fixed_inventory to protocol index 0. Seed0/replicate0 and every other row field are unchanged. Six bundles are not independent samples. Admission, adapter and retained original failure are hash-bound in files; final correction receipt is archived separately.
